title.narrative: Towards a dignified life for all sanitation workers in Bangladesh

description.narrative: INV-042354: Towards a Dignified Life for All Sanitation Workers in Bangladesh. This is to support informal workers to form co-operatives through to build entrepreneurial skills, design occupational and social safety net systems, and improve engagement in municipal and other government decision-making processes

participating-org.narrative: Greentech Foundation under the Outcome-3. The organisation is experienced in advocating on the issues on Green Financing. The Greentech foundation will work with Practical Action in finding 5 innovative and bankable business ideas, of which 2 will be supported by non-Banking Financial Institutes and/or Commercial Banks. Practical Action implemented a project in partnership with The Greentech Foundation, funded by the EU. The estimated cost for this subaward would be $8,000 for 2 years

Municipal Association of Bangladesh (MAB): will also be the implementing partner under Outcome-1 of this project. It will work with Practical Action in scaling the cooperative model and established cooperatives in additional 50 districts. MAB will also closely work with DPHE and LGED in arranging different advocacy events like workshops and orientations. It has also been a partner of one of the projects of Practical Action, funded by EU. The estimated cost for this subaward would be $6725 for 2 years

The Metal (Tvt.) Ltd. will be the implementing partner under Outcome-2 of this project. It is a business entity by its nature. Practical Action has been working with Metal with its other projects, including the last phase of this project, funded by Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation. The firm has proven its efficiency and proactiveness in doing activities that are stated in the Outcome-2. It will be involved in transferring and scaling the PitVaq technology in Bangladesh for mechanical desludging by the waste and sanitation workers. The estimated cost for this subaward would be $13,450 for 2 years

The Society Development Committee (SDC): will be conducting the activities that are mostly under the Outcome-1. It will be mobilizing the city level networks in 10 cities – capacity building of the cooperatives, building awareness, networking with the municipalities and related government agencies like the Department of Cooperatives. It will also get the city level networks on board in support of Practical Action. The Society Development Committee is a national NGO by its entity. It has got experience in creating cooperatives for its previously implemented projects. The Society Development Committee is the implementing partner of the current project, funded by the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation. The estimated cost for this subaward would be $46,500 for 2 years
